# NEXORA API and route reference

72 routes. Routes under `/api/` return JSON; the others are HTML pages and form posts.

## Conventions

* **Authentication:** a signed session cookie (`nexora_session`, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax). The role is read from the database on every request.
* **CSRF:** every POST needs the token, as a form field `csrf_token` or the header `X-CSRFToken` (its value is in the page's `<meta name="csrf-token">`).
* **Success (JSON):** `{"ok": true, "data": {...}}`. Decimals are strings (exact); datetimes are ISO-8601 UTC ending in `Z`.
* **Failure (JSON):** `{"ok": false, "error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "fields": {...}}, "retry_after": n}`; `fields` and `retry_after` appear only when relevant. HTTP 429 and 503 also send `Retry-After`.
* **Wrong role or someone else's record:** 403 for the wrong role; 404 for a record you do not own (ids cannot be probed).

## Main request bodies

| Endpoint | JSON body |
|---|---|
| `POST /api/attendance/mark` | `{"qr": "NXR1.…", "latitude": n, "longitude": n, "accuracy": n, "location_error": "denied"}` (location fields optional; any `student_id` is ignored) |
| `POST /api/teacher/attendance-session` | `{"assignment_id": n, "classroom_id": n, "qr_validity_seconds": 15-600, "duration_minutes": 1-240, "geofence_enabled": bool, "latitude": n, "longitude": n, "radius_m": 5-1000, "min_accuracy_m": 5-500}` |
| `POST /api/student/sgpa/calculate` | `{"semester_number": 1-8, "grades": {"<subject id>": "<grade label>"}}` or `{"items": [{"credits": "4", "grade_point": "8"}]}` |
| `POST /api/student/cgpa/calculate` | `{}` (official results), `{"hypothetical": {"semester_number": n, "grades": {...}}}` or `{"items": [...]}` |

## Error codes

Codes returned in `error.code` by the services, with their HTTP status:

| Code | HTTP | Typical message |
|---|---|---|
| `already_marked` | 409 | Your attendance is already recorded for this session. |
| `device_reused` | 403 | Another student has already marked attendance from this device in this session. |
| `device_unregistered` | 403 | This browser has no device registration. Sign out, reload the login page and sign in again. |
| `duplicate_unit` | 409 | That unit number already exists for this subject. |
| `file_not_found` | 404 | This file is not available. Please contact your teacher or the administrator. |
| `file_required` | 422 | Choose a PDF file to upload. |
| `file_too_large` | 413 | (computed message) |
| `forbidden` | 403 | Your teacher profile is incomplete. |
| `invalid_file_type` | 422 | Only PDF files are allowed. |
| `invalid_pdf` | 422 | That file is not a valid PDF. |
| `location_denied` | 422 | Location permission was denied. Allow location access for this site in your browser settings and scan again. |
| `location_inaccurate` | 422 | (computed message) |
| `location_invalid` | 422 | The location sent by your device is not valid. |
| `location_missing` | 422 | Your location was not received. Turn on location services and scan again. |
| `no_change` | 409 | That is already the recorded attendance. |
| `no_data` | 404 | You have no published results yet, and nothing was entered to estimate. Enter grades for a semester or use manual entry. |
| `no_grades` | 422 | Select at least one grade for a subject that carries credits. |
| `no_grading_scheme` | 409 | No grading scheme has been configured yet. The institution's administrator must set a default grading scheme before GPA can be calculated. |
| `no_subjects` | 404 | No subjects are defined for that semester in your department. |
| `not_assigned` | 403 | You are not assigned to that subject and class. |
| `not_enrolled` | 403 | You are not enrolled in this subject. |
| `not_found` | 404 | That subject was not found. |
| `outside_radius` | 403 | (computed message) |
| `publish_not_allowed` | 403 | Only administrators may publish results at this institution. |
| `qr_expired` | 410 | This QR code has expired. Scan the current code on the teacher's screen. |
| `qr_invalid` | 400 | This QR code is not recognised. |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | Too many failed attempts. Wait a minute and try again. |
| `semester_not_current` | 409 | That assignment is not in the current semester. |
| `session_already_active` | 409 | A session is already active for this subject and class. Close it first. |
| `session_closed` | 409 | This attendance session has ended. |
| `session_still_open` | 409 | Close the session before correcting attendance. |
| `validation_error` | 422 | Add at least one subject. |

Generic codes from the framework: `authentication_required` (401), `forbidden` (403), `page_not_found` (404), `method_not_allowed` (405), `bad_request` (400, includes an expired CSRF token), `service_unavailable` (503, database unreachable), `something_went_wrong` (500; details are logged, never shown).
